title: Unify status colors with custom attributes
goal: Use var() to read colors that can be partially overridden in the same component.
summary: The text and border colors of the two status cards are controlled by the same CSS rule. Registered cards have exclusive theme colors, and cards to be verified use the default color.
tasks: Let .ticket text and border color use var(--ticket-color, #243447).
defines --ticket-color: #125a46 for .registered. Leave the other card with undefined variables as the default color.

example.note: -- The custom attributes at the beginning can be overridden by scope like ordinary attributes, and the second item of var is the backup value.

hint: Write the variables and values ​​in .registered so that the same component rules take values ​​on the two cards.
